content.short: Fida Finance is a risk transfer protocol on Cardano that fractionalizes insurance contracts into tradable assets.
content.description: Fida Finance is a blockchain-based risk transfer protocol on Cardano that connects insurance risk to alternative capital. By fractionalizing insurance contracts into tradable 'FiDa Cards,' the protocol creates a new asset class providing insurers with instant liquidity and investors with uncorrelated returns. The protocol leverages Cardano's EUTXO model to automate the lifecycle of policies, including parametric triggers for instant payouts. With AI-driven risk scoring, Fida Finance offers a transparent and efficient way to manage and trade global insurance risks.
